title.en: An Act Converting the Catarman Emergency Hospital in the Municipality of Catarman, Province of Samar, into a General Hospital to be Known as the Northern Samar General Hospital, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Converting the Catarman Emergency Hospital in the Municipality of Catarman, Province of Samar, into a General Hospital to be Known as the Northern Samar General Hospital, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Bệnh viện Cấp cứu Catarman thành Bệnh viện Đa khoa Northern Samar tại Đô thị Catarman, Tỉnh Samar, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะโรงพยาบาลฉุกเฉิน Catarman เป็น โรงพยาบาลทั่วไป Northern Samar ในเทศบาล Catarman จังหวัด Samar และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah status Rumah Sakit Gawat Darurat Catarman menjadi Rumah Sakit Umum Northern Samar di Kotamadya Catarman, Provinsi Samar, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menukar status Hospital Kecemasan Catarman kepada Hospital Besar Northern Samar di Perbandaran Catarman, Wilayah Samar, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

text.en: The Catarman Emergency Hospital in the Municipality of Catarman, Province of Samar, is converted into a general hospital to be known as the Northern Samar General Hospital.

The sum of two hundred thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the operation and maintenance of the said hospital. Such sums as may be necessary for its operation and maintenance in subsequent years shall be included in the General Appropriation Acts.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1960.
